The checkpoint was never created locally. This was a silent prepare/post-commit mismatch, not a push or checkpoint-remote failure.
Evidence:

At 17:38:12, checkpoint 01KX3RF0... was successfully condensed. This cleared the session’s tracked files.
At 17:38:27, the Pi session transitioned to idle.
A new Pi prompt arrived one second later, but no corresponding turn-start event appears in the Entire log.
Pi edited two files and committed them.
At 17:39:25, prepare-commit-msg generated and appended 01KX3RH9GBCZD3A40K3G6X1N9N.
There is no subsequent session condensed entry for that ID.
At 17:39:38, after the commit, turn-end handling migrated the session to c32690e and created a new ephemeral shadow checkpoint instead.
The failure mechanism is:

prepare-commit-msg found the new file operations by inspecting Pi’s live transcript, so it added the trailer.
post-commit saw an IDLE session whose persisted FilesTouched was empty.
For non-active sessions, it did not re-extract touched files from the live transcript.
The overlap guard therefore rejected condensation, silently leaving the commit with a dangling checkpoint trailer.
The relevant evidence is in [entire.log (line 1106)](/Users/peter/code/devenv/cli/.entire/logs/entire.log:1106) and the third Pi turn begins at [the Pi transcript (line 60)](/Users/peter/.pi/agent/sessions/--Users-peter-code-devenv-cli--/2026-07-09T15-31-37-593Z_019f4781-81f9-753d-ab2e-bd75b0cec3cf.jsonl:60). The current implementation still has the active-only file fallback in [manual_commit_hooks.go (line 1255)](/Users/peter/code/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go:1255), so this scenario appears to remain possible.
This disproves two initial hypotheses:

It was not lost during push: the persistent checkpoint was never written locally.
Checkpoint ID generation did not fail: the ID was successfully generated and added to the commit.
Fix direction: add a regression test for IDLE + empty FilesTouched + new live-transcript edits, then either re-extract files during post-commit or persist the positive prepare-hook association. Separately, investigate why Pi did not emit turn-start for that third, rapidly submitted trail-review prompt. Also, a warning should be logged whenever a commit contains a trailer but no checkpoint is materialized.

752	// shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck returns true if the session should be condensed
753	// into this commit. Active sessions with recent interaction condense unless they
754	// have no tracked files and another session claims the committed files (read-only
755	// gate). Stale ACTIVE and IDLE/ENDED sessions require file overlap evidence
756	// between tracked files and committed files.
757	func (h *postCommitActionHandler) shouldCondenseWithOverlapCheck(isActive bool, lastInteraction *time.Time) bool {
758		if !h.hasNew {
759			return false
760		}
761		// ACTIVE sessions with recent interaction: skip the overlap check.
762		// PrepareCommitMsg already validated this commit is session-related
763		// (added trailer). The overlap check is only meaningful when we need
764		// heuristic evidence that a commit was related to the session.
765		//
766		// Exception: when another session's tracked files overlap with the
767		// committed files, skip this ACTIVE session if it has no tracked files
768		// itself. This prevents read-only sessions (e.g., codex exec from tools
769		// like summarize) from being condensed when a different session's commit
770		// triggers PostCommit. When no other session claims the committed files,
771		// the ACTIVE session is assumed to own the commit.
772		//
773		// We check LastInteractionTime to avoid condensing stale ACTIVE sessions
774		// (agent killed without Stop hook) into every subsequent commit. A stale
775		// session has no recent interaction and falls through to the overlap check.
776		if isActive && isRecentInteraction(lastInteraction) {
777			if h.sessionsWithCommittedFiles > 0 && len(h.filesTouchedBefore) == 0 {
778				logging.Debug(h.ctx, "post-commit: skipping read-only ACTIVE session (no tracked files, other sessions claim committed files)",
779					slog.Int("sessions_with_committed_files", h.sessionsWithCommittedFiles),
780				)
781				return false
782			}
783			return true
784		}
785		if len(h.filesTouchedBefore) == 0 {
786			return false // No files tracked = no overlap evidence
787		}
788		// Only check files that were actually changed in this commit.
789		// Without this, files that exist in the tree but weren't changed
790		// would pass the "modified file" check in filesOverlapWithContent
791		// (because the file exists in the parent tree), causing stale
792		// sessions to be incorrectly condensed.
793		var committedTouchedFiles []string
794		for _, f := range h.filesTouchedBefore {
795			if _, ok := h.committedFileSet[f]; ok {
796				committedTouchedFiles = append(committedTouchedFiles, f)
797			}
798		}
799		if len(committedTouchedFiles) == 0 {
800			return false
801		}
802		return filesOverlapWithContent(h.ctx, h.repo, h.shadowBranchName, h.commit, committedTouchedFiles, overlapOpts{
803			headTree:      h.headTree,
804			shadowTree:    h.shadowTree,
805			parentTree:    h.parentTree,
806			hasParentTree: true,
807		})
808	}
